Downtown Tacoma.name: Downtown Tacoma
Downtown Tacoma.description: Tacoma's civic and office core around Pacific Avenue with the UW Tacoma campus, the Tacoma Dome district, and steady mixed-use and institutional permitting.

Stadium District.name: Stadium District
Stadium District.description: Historic Stadium High neighborhood with early-20th-century homes, the Wright Park corridor, and steady residential renovation permits.

North End.name: North End
North End.description: Established residential North End with Proctor Street retail, large-lot homes, and consistent high-value remodels.

Ruston / Point Ruston.name: Ruston / Point Ruston
Ruston / Point Ruston.description: Waterfront mixed-use redevelopment on Commencement Bay with Point Ruston condos, the Ruston Way corridor, and premium residential construction.

Sixth Avenue.name: Sixth Avenue
Sixth Avenue.description: Sixth Avenue commercial corridor with neighborhood retail, restaurants, taverns, and high business-license turnover.

Hilltop.name: Hilltop
Hilltop.description: Rapidly revitalizing Hilltop corridor along Martin Luther King Jr Way with new mixed-use, the light-rail-adjacent development, and high 311-to-permit activity.

Lincoln District.name: Lincoln District
Lincoln District.description: Diverse Eastside commercial district along South 38th and the Lincoln Business District with dense small-business licensing.

Eastside / Salishan.name: Eastside / Salishan
Eastside / Salishan.description: Eastside neighborhoods from Portland Avenue to the Salishan redevelopment with infill housing and community-serving commercial.

South Tacoma.name: South Tacoma
South Tacoma.description: South Tacoma's auto-row and light-industrial belt along South Tacoma Way with warehouse conversions and commercial permitting.

Wapato / South End.name: Wapato / South End
Wapato / South End.description: Southern residential belt around Wapato Lake and the South End with single-family infill and steady service permits.
